questions.text: Maple & Birch Opportunity Zone Fund I sent a 2024 K-1 and nothing for 2025. Has anything arrived from them, and did the fund extend? If you extended your own return, it is due October 15, 2026.
Riverbend Storage Partners sent its final 2026 short-year K-1, but no 2025 K-1 is on file. Did one arrive anywhere else?

The 2025 Cedar Ridge Growth Fund III K-1 names Marcus Quill. You told X1 the trust holds this investment, but no subscription agreement is on file. Which owner should the 2025 K-1 name, and should we ask the fund to correct it?

An amended 2024 Juniper Street K-1, issued April 2, 2026, changes section 1231 gain from 129,870 to 137,320. The 2024 return on file was filed April 11, 2025. Does it need to be amended? The section 751 statement the K-1 references did not turn up in the document's search results.
Cedar Ridge's K-1 box 16 says a Schedule K-3 is attached, but no K-3 pages turned up in this document's search results. Please send the K-3.
The Quill Studio 2025 K-1 box 17 code V says 'see attached statement', but no section 199A statement turned up in the document's search results. Please send it.
Juniper Street Duplex LLC issued a 2025 K-1 after the 2024 sale and final K-1. What does the 2025 K-1 cover?

Both Harbor Lane K-1s and the operating agreement name the trust as a 60% member, but the trust's Schedule A lists only $10 in cash. Was the Harbor Lane interest assigned to the trust, and is the assignment on file?

Riverbend's final short-year K-1 (January 1 to March 31, 2026) is printed on the 2025 form. It belongs with the 2026 return; X1's checks for 2026 aren't published yet, so it was reviewed for identity and version only.
This list covers the interests your X1 record shows. Have you made any investments since the record was last updated that should be on it?
Tamarack Ag Partners' K-1 covers its fiscal year July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2025, on the 2024 form. Its year ends in 2025, so it goes on the 2025 return. It is Marcus's first Tamarack K-1 on file.

receipt.coverage: The register covers interests the record shows (prior-year K-1s and current entities). It cannot show investments the household made since then; the review asks.

set_question_text.text: The entire $18,420 rental loss can be deducted this year.
The $18,420 rental loss is fully deductible, so there is nothing to ask.
